reason: Verified in code and by driving. lately.html line 745 renders VIEW.partial as movementOne({ record: false }); chart() then emits neither the .record line nor the sentence "The best week before this one was 8" in the chart's screen-reader line. Driving ?state=partial confirms it: .record is absent, the chart's sr text ends at "13 Jul, 12 so far.", and /best week/i does not appear anywhere in body text — while full and quiet both render "Best week · 8". The removal has no source behind it. bestPrior is Math.max(...F.weeks.slice(0,-1).map(w=>w.v)) = 8, derived from the same F.weeks array whose twelve bars are still drawn in partial, and SOURCES.partial says Tasks answered; only Timeline is out, and Timeline governs due dates, which is why the overdue KPI alone resolves to "Not available". So the surface removes a mark it fully knows, from an answering source, in a state whose declared degradation is a different source, with no word anywhere: the KPI note says only "Timeline did not answer this reading, so nothing here knows a due date", and the coverage strip reads "Tasks answered". This is not restating the gates. interaction-check.mjs's honest-degradation block inspects only .kpi cards (naSaysWords, naReadsZero, naHasMeter); its .record assertion runs on state=full. Nothing in either gate looks at the chart in partial, which is exactly why this survived. It is also a paid-for class creeping back — lessons.md §"Silent content deletion" and the rule that a surface must state what no longer fits rather than silently drop it. The codebase already knows the right answer: first-run has no record line either, but it says so in words ("Four weeks of records make a comparison worth printing. Yours arrive on 10 August."). Partial is the one state that deletes the mark and stays quiet. Severity: the seat's "defect" is correct and not overstated. The screen asserts nothing false — no fabricated zero, no wrong number — so it is not misleading; it is visibly wrong against the honest-degradation contract and passable in a single reading. It only becomes corrosive across readings, which is the seat's point, but that is still defect, not misleading. The proposed fix is right and I accept it: max = Math.max(D.peak, D.bestPrior) = max(12, 8) = 12 either way, so restoring the line changes no bar height and no gridline value — it adds one dashed hairline and its tag and nothing else.
sharpenedFix: In VIEW.partial (lately.html line 745), change movementOne({ record: false }) to movementOne(). Nothing else needs to move: max is unchanged at 12, the gridlines stay 12 and 6, every column keeps its height, and the chart's sr line regains "The best week before this one was 8." — the sentence that makes the mark reach a screen reader. Then close the loop on the flag itself, because after this change no caller passes record:false: first-run does not call chart() at all (it builds its own inline .chart block), so the parameter becomes dead surface on both chart() and movementOne(). Either delete it, or — better, and this is the seat's second branch — keep it and bind it to the condition it was presumably written for: record should be false only when bestPrior is genuinely unknowable (fewer than two completed weeks of history), and in that case the chart must say so in words where the line would sit, in the same register the unavailable KPI card uses ("Best week · not yet" / a one-line note naming why), never by silence. Derive it rather than typing it: record = D.weeks.length > 1, not a per-state literal, so no future state can switch a knowable mark off by hand again.
breaks: Very little, and nothing structural. The partial plot's geometry is identical to full's (measured: .plot box 579,395.84,686x168 in both at 1440), so the restored line and tag render exactly where they already render in full and quiet. Re-measure anyway: (1) re-run audit.mjs — .record-tag is ink-3 #71717a on a --paper chip over the plot, already AA-passing in full/quiet, but the composited backdrop check should be re-taken for the partial frame; (2) re-shoot shots/light-partial--1440x960.png and the dark partial frame, since the asset gate compares committed frames against the master and this changes the partial frame; (3) collision — I measured .record-tag against the "12 so far" bar-val and both gridline labels at 390, 768, 1280 and 1440 in the full state and found zero overlap at every width, so the restored tag is safe across the ramp, but re-check after any change to the record value, since the tag sits at right:0/top:-18px and would collide with the top gridline label if bestPrior ever equalled peak. (4) If the sharpened derived form (record = D.weeks.length > 1) is taken instead of the literal, re-run interaction-check.mjs in full: its "the previous best draws last, after the columns have grown" assertion queries document.querySelector('.record') unguarded and will throw, not fail, if any state it opens ever loses the line.
